independent_reviews.p3_findings: four non-blocking hardening notes: group-writable child directories, ctime semantics, OSError classification consistency, and root path replacement threat model

known_p3_follow_ups: Reject group-writable pre-existing objects/staging child directories, not only a group/world-writable root.
Avoid treating inode ctime as true object creation time metadata.
Normalize the startup-probe final fsync failure into the configuration-error type while preserving fail-closed startup.
Add O_CLOEXEC where supported to local adapter file descriptors.
Do not treat device-plus-inode identity as globally unique over long retention horizons.
Reject a root beneath a broken .git symlink as being inside a Git worktree.
Operationalize bounded staging-orphan inventory and cleanup for the pilot without request-path sweeping.
Keep native Windows development on the documented Docker/WSL Linux boundary.

reproduction.reviewed_files: For each reviewed_snapshot.files entry, hash the bytes from the reviewed snapshot commit with SHA-256 and compare the lowercase digest.
reproduction.aggregate: Sort reviewed_snapshot.files by ordinal-ignore-case path, render each digest/path line using aggregate_algorithm and SHA-256 the resulting bytes.
reproduction.generated_manifest: The manifest is evidence about the reviewed snapshot and is intentionally not part of its self-referential 22-file digest. Verify its Git blob identity from the evidence commit tree.
